Quick start

Your first projection.

  1. Open the app

    Run the Windows EXE to unpack and launch the app. For the ZIP, choose Extract All, then double-click PotatoMapper.exe in the extracted folder.

  2. Connect your projector

    Plug your projector into your PC. Press Windows + P and choose Extend. In Potato Mapper, select your projector under Projector output.

  3. Map a Christmas scene

    Open File → Examples → Santa's Sleigh Ride. Click Start output, then drag the surface corners in the editor to fit the projection.

Project the subject by itself

For the train, tree, clocktower or nutcracker, select its surface and turn on Potato FX → Subject only. A lower layer can show through the empty space. With nothing underneath, the projector output is black there.

Windows requirements

Windows 11 or Windows 10 22H2 on a 64-bit Intel or AMD PC, with an OpenGL 3.3 Core graphics driver.

Portable ZIP and download help

The Windows EXE puts the app in a folder next to the download. For the ZIP, right-click it and choose Extract All. Open the top-level PotatoMapper.exe and keep its versions folder beside it.

GitHub’s Source code archives contain the developer files. Use one of the Windows downloads on this page to run the app.

If it still won’t start, include your Windows version and any error message in a support issue.
